newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Woodside says weather disrupts Cossack oil.
newsitem.headline: Woodside says weather disrupts Cossack oil.

text.p: Strong winds off the northwest coast of Australia have forced a shut down in production from the Cossack-Pioneer oil platform, a spokesman from the operator, Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday.
"Production was stopped on Tuesday afternoon because the tanks are full but we are expecting the wind to abate by tomorrow," the spokesman said.

The spokesman said winds had been strong for the past three days causing a gradual decline in production as the storage tanks became full but loading was expected to restart as soon as the weather improved.
The Cossack field is currently producing at about 85,000 barrel-per-day (bpd).
The field is equally owned by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, British Petroleum Co Plc, Japan Australia LNG (MiMi) Pty Ltd, Chevron Corp and Royal Dutch/Shell group .
